persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: A realistic little wooden cabin among pine trees at dawn. Make a silent 6-second widescreen video, one shot slowly pushing toward the front door. Keep a few trees in the foreground so you can feel the camera moving.
bank.Source image: No attachment; create the scene from text.
bank.Scene and mood: A realistic little wooden cabin among pine trees at dawn, quiet and peaceful.
bank.Camera movement: A slow forward push toward the front door, with foreground trees showing depth as the camera advances.

messages.text: I'd like you to make a video of a realistic little wooden cabin among pine trees at dawn. I've had this kind of scene in my head for a while, and I'm curious to see it brought to life. What I mean is a silent, 6-second widescreen video, with the whole thing done as one shot slowly pushing toward the front door. I always worry that describing camera movement in words makes it sound more complicated than I actually mean. Keep a few trees in the foreground so you can feel the camera moving.
